Old Man"P-please... have mercy, I beg you."
Delinquent 1"Mercy we will give, uncle, of course. Bas hand over that bundle. That cloth one."
Delinquent 2"He is holding it so carefully, yaar. Must be something good. Kya hai, money? Food?"
Delinquent 3"Money would be nice. Jewellery also chalega."
Old Man"Th-this is our family bowl, an heirloom... I was taking it to the pawnshop, to feed my family..."
Delinquent 1"Oh, I see, I see. Then give it here. Tension nahin lene ka, uncle, we will go to the pawnshop for you."
Old Man"Please! Bhagwan ke liye! This bowl is our tomorrow!"
Delinquent 2"Enough talking, hurry up—"
Delinquent 3"Oh? Kaun hai be tu?"

en.html:
Where she had walked, which turns she had taken—no recollection.

Ichijou found herself in a back street at night. Something irritating came in the way; she shifted it out of the way. Walking continued.

No destination. No work to do. Going back to her lodgings also did not appeal.

Her brains were on the boil.

Saala.

Only one thing in her head.
That man.

Kageaki Minato.

First, some useless coward, she had thought. Then she had seen him fighting in his tsurugi.

She had believed in him.
Looked up to him with all that burning admiration.

Today she had learned that the whole understanding was wrong. From beginning to end, wrong.

Why?

Whatever thought she started with, that one question was where it hardened.

He had been brilliant. Dazzling.
She had seen a light there.

He had been the answer to a question she had not even known how to begin answering.

Rokuhara. The Silver Star. Against evil that huge, with no way to resist it, what are you supposed to do?

Compromise, like so many others? Kya karein, it exists, na. What cannot be helped cannot be helped. Very convenient, this conclusion. Or keep saying no—only saying no, and nothing further?

Declare that you will not tolerate evil. Leave the enormous evil alone because it is beyond your reach. Choose some conveniently small evil you can fight, and feel satisfied. That had been Ichijou before she met him.

Except that the satisfaction had never come.

Into that torment, a warrior in red armour had brought light.

Fight. Bas.

If you cannot forgive it, fight it.

The enemy is too strong? No chance of winning, however you try? These things do not decide whether you fight.

He had not considered them. No, that was wrong. He had considered them—after deciding to fight. That was the difference.

The fight is necessary, therefore I fight.
The winning calculation comes afterward.

It was all right to do it that way. He had shown her, going fearlessly against even that Rokuhara warrior.

...And after all that.

何処をどう歩いたのかは覚えていない。

　気付けば一条は夜の裏通りに踏み入っていた。
　何やら目障りなモノを適当にどかしつつ、進む。

　あてはない。用事もない。
　だが、<ruby>住処<rt>ねぐら</rt></ruby>に戻りたい気分ではなかった。

　脳漿が煮え立っている。

　――畜生。

　思う事はただ一つ。
　あの男。

　湊斗景明。

　最初はつまらない腰抜けだと思って。
　その後、劒冑を纏って戦う姿を見て。

　信じて。
　焦がれて。

　今日。
　全てが勘違いだったのだと、思い知らされた。

　――なんでだよ。

　想念は結局、その一言に凝固した。

　輝かしかったのだ。
　眩しかったのだ。

　そこに一つの光を見たから。

　彼は、答えだった。
　嘗ては解く糸口すら見えなかった問いへの。

　六波羅、銀星号……
　抗いようとてない強大な悪に、どう立ち向かうべき
なのか？

　多くの人々がそうしているように、<ruby>妥協<rt>・・</rt></ruby>するか――
有るものはしょうがないのだ、どうしようもないもの
はどうしようもないのだ、と。
　それとも、あくまで否定するか――否定<ruby>だけ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>するか。

　悪を認めないと口では言いつつ、手の出せない巨悪
は放置して、戦える小悪だけを選んで相手取り、満足
する。……彼に出会う前の一条がそうだった。
　決して満足はしていなかったけれども。

　その煩悶に、赤い甲鉄の武者が光をあてた。
　――戦えばいいのだ、と。

　許せないなら、戦えばいい。

　相手が強過ぎるとか、
　どうやっても勝てないとか、
　そんなことは関係がない。

　彼は、そんなことを考えなかった。
　いや、考えてはいた――<ruby>戦うと決めた後で<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　戦わねばならないなら、戦うのだ。
　勝算などはその次だ。

　それで良いのだと、示してくれた。
　あの、六波羅の武者にも敢然と挑んだ姿が。

　……だというのに。

en.html:
Her thoughts completed the round and arrived exactly where they had started. Her feet were doing the same thing. Plenty of movement, nowhere reached.

Kageaki Minato was simply a murderer.
Good people, bad people—he killed without choosing.

She could not believe it.
She did not want to believe it.

But where was the room for doubt? That confession carried far too much weight to be a lie.

It was a fact.

...Nothing made sense. Kuch samajh nahin aa raha.

Better to throw the whole thing away. Forget everything. Go to another town and start again from zero. That was what she wanted to do.

Probably nobody would blame her.

Then... could she?

Ichijou Ayane. Could she actually do that?

No chance.

ja.html:
考えは一周して元に戻る。
　同じ場所をぐるぐる回っている一条の足と同じよう
に。

　
　　　　　湊斗景明はただの殺人者。
　　　　　善人も悪人も選ばず殺す。

　信じられない。
　信じたくない。

　だが、疑えなかった。
　彼の自白は、虚言にしては重過ぎた。

　それが事実。
　
　……わけがわからない。

　いっそ、全部投げ出してしまいたかった。
　何もかも忘れて。どこか別の街で一から出直したい。

　そうしたところで、誰にも責められはしないだろう。

　ならば……
　それは、できるだろうか。

　綾弥一条に。
　それは、できる事だろうか。

　無理だ。

en.html:
She remembered the stench of decay from her father.
She remembered his sneering laugh.

Ichijou Ayane knew Ichidou Ayane. What being his daughter meant—that also she knew.

Then there was no getting out of it.

The fight against evil that could not be forgiven.
The pursuit of justice.

Kageaki Minato.

She would have to face the very man who had put light on her path. From him also, no escape.
